summary: What may become of a path of a host's PRIOR agent system when this kit takes over (ADR-011). Assigned only by a host's migration map; a reading measures, and never assigns.

undecided.says: No row of the migration map answers this path. It is counted and named, and nothing may be applied while it stands -- an unanswered path is never defaulted to any disposition below.

dispositions.says: The bytes are good and move INTO a plane of this kit, at the stated place. For a row naming a directory, every path below it keeps its remainder below the destination.
What this path did is done by a declared capability of this kit; the path itself does not survive the takeover.
Nothing takes this path's place; it leaves the host's tree at the takeover, for the stated reason.
